svg.title: Khooneh 1405 · kitchen C · 1:20
svg.text: Khooneh · design 1405 · kitchen of home C (F2 c-kitchen) · 1:20 on A1

Plan: symbols cut at 1.1 m, zones (dots), the cook's strip (tinted), the things on the worktop and rail. Elevations: modules by code (D1-D3 drawers, B base, SB sink base, W1-W2 wall units, O open shelf dashed, L larder), worktop at 0.90 m. From scenarios-ai.json (the kitchen plan on the picks). The AI's proposal, not checked by an engineer.

g.title: dining table with chairs, runner, fruit bowl and a water jug; 6x, 4x, 4x8 and gl are the everyday tables, extendable for guests (kitchen_plan.py; 4x8 seats four every day and eight open at 2.0 m; gl, the drop-leaf, two every day and four open at 1.52 m) · میز ناهارخوری با صندلی؛ 6x و 4x و 4x8 و gl میزهای روزانه‌اند که برای مهمان باز می‌شوند (4x8 هر روز چهار نفر و باز هشت نفر، ۲٫۰ متر؛ gl میز تاشو، هر روز دو نفر و باز چهار نفر، ۱٫۵۲ متر)
